text: Figure 10.7: LIN Interface Schedule Table configuration [ECUC_LinIf_00365] Definition of EcucParamConfContainerDef LinIfSchedule Table ⌈ Container Name LinIfScheduleT able Parent Container LinIfChannel Description Describes a schedule table. Each LinIfChannel may have several schedule tables. Each schedule table can only be connected to one channel. Mandatory for LIN Master nodes. The SHORT -NAME of the LinIfScheduleT able container represents the symbolic name of the schedule table. ▽
